03-violin-plot-orchestra.visual_critic_note: Intentional Tol-Bright palette and clean typographic hierarchy show real design care, but the 88px cell height squashes violin shapes into narrow spindles — Singapore's near-zero-variance distributions degenerate to horizontal lines, breaking the distributional encoding for the most geographically interesting row.
03-violin-plot-orchestra.encoding_integrity_note: Shared global maxDensity scale and data-driven Silverman bandwidth ensure honest cross-cell comparison, but the minimum-width clamp (Math.max(w, 1.8)) slightly inflates low-variance distributions like Singapore, introducing a minor lie factor for narrow violins.
03-violin-plot-orchestra.stress_test_note: Static render with pointer-event-only interactions; no brush/zoom storms, no transitions to interrupt, no cross-view dispatch, and Pointer Events API correctly unifies mouse/touch — only trivial DOM updates on pointerenter (not continuous drag).
03-violin-plot-orchestra.cognitive_load_note: 72-cell grid (6 cities × 12 months) stays readable because it functions as a single pattern-comparison unit with a restrained 2-color palette, shared y-axis, and clear row/column semantics — the main risk is cell size (~83×88px) making individual violin shapes hard to read at smaller viewports.
